house.name: Pre-Swap Payment
house.description: Cast a vote for a **Pre-Swap** Tribal Council.

house.name: Swap Payment
house.description: Cast a vote for a Tribal Council *following* an eventual **Tribe Swap.**

house.name: Early Merge Payment
house.description: Cast a vote for a Tribal Council *following* the **Merge** phase.

house.name: Late Merge Payment
house.description: Cast a vote for a Tribal Council from the **F7 onward.**

special.intro: **Two** Store Specials will be in rotation each round.

golden.intro: **Three** Golden Tools will be in rotation each round.

standard.intro: **Four** Standard Tools will be in rotation each round.

cabinet.intro: **All** items available 24/7... but cheap tools ain't reliable!
cabinet.footer: *You can only hold one watering can at a time — they don't stack. Trade in with a host to switch (no refund).*

loan.intro: Every time you wish to cast a vote in this game, you must make a **House Payment.**

items.name: Nook Family Tax Returns
items.description: See EVERY Nook's Cranny item currently owned by people in the game. No names attached.

items.name: Resetti's Do-Over
items.description: Sets your current challenge score to **0.** Next round, your challenge result is **doubled** — time halved, or score doubled.

items.name: Redd's Counterfeit
items.description: Send a fake shop advantage to another player. They won't know it's fake until they try to use it.

items.name: Isabelle's Briefing
items.description: Full vote reveal breakdown from any past Tribal Council, with all names.

items.name: Kapp'n's Island Tour
items.description:
Spend one round with viewing access to another tribe's chat, including Tribal Council if they attend.
At the end of the cycle, you may opt to **mutiny** to this tribe with Immunity for ONE episode.

items.name: May Day Ticket
items.description: Individual advantage for an upcoming twist. You won't know what it is or does until you buy it, but it's worth it.

items.name: Pete's Special Delivery
items.description:
Deliver bells or an item to another player. Pay 250 in shipping, plus whatever you're sending.
The angel to Redd's devil.

items.name: Golden Shovel
items.description: Negates **SIX** votes cast against you.

items.name: Golden Axe
items.description: **Steal** another player's vote **AND** cast one **extra vote.** Cannot be blocked or negated.

items.name: Golden Slingshot
items.description: **Pre-Play** (in Submissions) on someone else to attempt an **advantage interception** as it's being used. You **decide who it will be played on instead**.

items.name: Golden Rod
items.description: Negate anywhere between **3 to 5** votes against you. (Random chance)

items.name: Golden Watering Can
items.description:
**Permanently** reduces all of your command cooldowns by **50%.**
You can only buy this **once.**

items.name: Shovel
items.description: Negates **TWO** votes cast against you.

items.name: Axe
items.description: Allows you to **steal** another player's vote.

items.name: Slingshot
items.description:
Target a player at Tribal Council — they will be **stunned** and cannot use Regular & Golden Tools that round.
Cannot stack with other Slingshots & variants.

items.name: Vaulting Pole
items.description: **+25%** to your score in the next challenge.

items.name: Stone Axe
items.description: **Guarantees** vote-blocking power.

items.name: Ladder
items.description: Cast an **extra vote** at Tribal Council. Carries over to a re-vote.

items.name: Star Wand
items.description:
Roll for a **1 in 6** chance at Immunity.
You may buy/use multiple of these to **stack** and increase your odds.

items.name: Watering Can
items.description: **Permanently** reduces all of your command cooldowns by **25%.**

items.name: Flimsy Shovel
items.description: Negates 1 vote against you. **25% chance** it snaps first.

items.name: Flimsy Axe
items.description: Has a **25% chance** to block a player from voting.

items.name: Flimsy Slingshot
items.description:
Has a **25% chance** to **stun** a player from using Regular Tools.
Cannot stack with other Slingshots & variants.

items.name: Flimsy Watering Can
items.description: Reduces all of your command cooldowns by **10%** for your next **10 commands.**

items.name: +1 Islander
items.description: Add another buddy to your confessional channel.
